# Solatide Biosciences

> Australian supplier of research-grade peptides, analytical reference standards and laboratory support materials. Every batch is independently third-party tested (HPLC-UV purity, LC-MS identity) with a lot-specific Certificate of Analysis. All products are for in-vitro laboratory research use only — not for human or animal consumption, therapeutic, diagnostic or cosmetic use.

Prices are in AUD. Orders ship from Melbourne, Australia.

## About

- [About Solatide Biosciences | Quality Research Peptides](https://solatidebiosciences.com.au/pages/about): Learn about Solatide Biosciences, an Australian-operated research supplier focused on third-party verification, documentation, and dependable support.
- [Lab Testing & Analytical Verification](https://solatidebiosciences.com.au/pages/coa-lab-testing): Learn how Solatide Biosciences verifies research compound purity and identity through independent third-party testing, including HPLC-UV and LC-MS analysis.
- [Research Use Disclaimer](https://solatidebiosciences.com.au/pages/research-use-disclaimer): Important disclaimer: All products are for research use only. Not for human or veterinary consumption. Buyer responsibility and compliance requirements.
- [Contact Solatide Biosciences | Peptide Enquiries Australia](https://solatidebiosciences.com.au/pages/contact-us): Contact Solatide Biosciences for order support, shipping updates, documentation requests, and general enquiries. Support & dispatch: Melbourne, VIC 3000.

## Shop

- [Research Grade Peptides](https://solatidebiosciences.com.au/collections/all): Browse research peptides, analytical reference standards and laboratory compounds with batch documentation and COAs. For in-vitro research use only.
- [GLP-1 & Metabolic Research Peptides Australia](https://solatidebiosciences.com.au/collections/glp-1-metabolic-peptides): Research-grade GLP-1 receptor agonists, dual agonists, triple agonists, and metabolic research compounds. COA-verified. For in-vitro laboratory use only.
- [Tissue & Cellular Research Peptides | BPC-157 TB-500 AU](https://solatidebiosciences.com.au/collections/tissue-cellular-research-peptides): Browse tissue and cellular research peptides including BPC-157, TB-500, and combined-pathway compounds for in-vitro laboratory research. COA verified.
- [Dermal & Pigmentation Research Peptides MT2 GHK-Cu Australia](https://solatidebiosciences.com.au/collections/dermal-pigmentation-research): Solatide Biosciences dermal and pigmentation research peptides, including MT2 and GHK-Cu. Melanocortin receptor and copper peptide compounds with COA.
- [Research Solutions | Laboratory Support Materials](https://solatidebiosciences.com.au/collections/research-solutions): Laboratory support materials and sterile solvents for peptide handling, preparation, and controlled in-vitro research workflows. For laboratory use only.
- [Research Peptides Bundles](https://solatidebiosciences.com.au/collections/bundles): Research peptide bundles and multi-vial combinations for comprehensive in-vitro laboratory analysis.

## Research resources

- [Research Resource Hub](https://solatidebiosciences.com.au/pages/research-library): A central directory of research resources from Solatide Biosciences — including the Peptide Guide, Compound Index, COA library, concentration calculator and FAQ.
- [Research Peptide Guide](https://solatidebiosciences.com.au/pages/research-peptides-guide): A plain-language guide to research peptides — covering common categories, laboratory use, handling, quality documentation and research-use terminology. For in-vitro research use only.
- [Compound Index](https://solatidebiosciences.com.au/pages/research-compound-database): Browse Solatide's research compound index by name, category and receptor pathway. Each entry links to product pages, batch documentation and available COA information. For in-vitro research use only.
- [Concentration Calculator](https://solatidebiosciences.com.au/pages/concentration-calculator): Concentration calculator for math conversions and dilution calculations. Educational reference tool for research use only.
- [Certificates of Analysis](https://solatidebiosciences.com.au/pages/coa): Access batch-specific certificates of analysis for Solatide Biosciences research peptides. Third-party analytical documentation by product and batch.
- [FAQs - Research Peptides](https://solatidebiosciences.com.au/pages/faq): Find answers about dispatch, tracking, documentation, support, restocks, and research-use policies at Solatide Biosciences.
